title: Temari ionization form-factor table (schema_version 2)
description: One file per channel (Z, subshell). Each row is one incident beam energy E0. This schema is normative for schema_version 2, shipped as dataset v5.x. NOTE the sign and unit conventions in the property descriptions - they are the part most often got wrong by consumers.

schema_version.description: 2 changed the meaning of row.tail from {a,b} (exponential extrapolation) to {kind,eps,valid_to,source} (measured upper bound), and added row.s_cert_A_inv. The exponential tail of schema 1 was neither an approximation nor an upper bound - do not resurrect it.

dataset_version.description: Semantic version of the DATA, independent of the software version. '0.0.0-dev' means the file was produced with a prescription or grid outside the shipping contract and MUST NOT be packed for release.

model_id.description: Full prescription identifier. Every file in a set must carry the same value; a set with mixed model_id is not a dataset.

provenance.description: model_id with the generation suffix stripped.

generator_commit.description: Short git hash of the generator. A '-dirty' suffix means the working tree had uncommitted tracked changes and the result is NOT reproducible from the hash. Different files in one set MAY carry different hashes when a commit landed mid-fleet-run; that is only acceptable if src/ and tools/ are unchanged between them.

bote_subshell.description: Bote-Salvat subshell index used for the edge energy and sigma.

kappa.description: Dirac quantum number of the initial state. kappa = l for j = l-1/2, kappa = -(l+1) for j = l+1/2.

occ_init.description: Occupancy of the initial subshell (2j+1 for a closed subshell).

e_th_keV_bote.description: Edge energy [keV] from the Bote-Salvat tables, NOT the solver's own eigenvalue. The two differ by 0.5-1.6 % for shallow levels (Koopmans-type eigenvalue vs experimental edge); that is expected, not a defect.

s_grid_A_inv.description: Scattering parameter s [A^-1], strictly increasing, s[0] = 0 exactly. CONVENTION: the momentum transfer is q = 4*pi*s [A^-1], equivalently K = 4*pi*s*a0 in atomic units. Identical in every file of a set. v5 ships 321 uniform points 0..16.

settings.description: Quadrature knobs actually used. Present so a consumer can tell HIGH from PROD output.

prescription.description: Human-readable statement of the physics (bound state, continuum, exchange, final state).

failures.description: Rows that failed a generation gate. MUST be empty in a shipping set. WARNING: empty does not imply healthy - v4 and v5 each produced corrupted rows that passed every generation gate and were caught only by QC (check_tables C11).

rel_continuum.description: true selects the v3 scalar-relativistic continuum, which has a known defect (docs/src_defect_2026-08-07.md). false in every shipping set from v4 on.

generated_utc_note.description: Timestamps are deliberately omitted so output is deterministic.

e0_keV.description: Incident beam energy [keV]. Rows are sorted ascending. The E0 axis differs between channels - do not assume a shared axis.

F.description: Shape factor F(s) on s_grid_A_inv, one value per grid point. F[0] = 1 exactly (normalization). *** F IS SIGNED AND CHANGES SIGN AT HIGH s. *** Consumers must not clip, abs, or assume monotonicity: 338+ sign flips occur even in the K shell. Entries at s > s_cert_A_inv are exact zeros (padding), not computed values.

N0.description: N(K=0), the normalization denominator. A value orders of magnitude out of line along E0 is the fingerprint of a corrupted row.

s_cert_A_inv.description: Kinematic guarantee limit for THIS row: min(s_max, 0.98/lambda) rounded down to a grid point. Beyond it the table carries exact zeros. The bound is geometric (no Bloch pair with that difference vector exists on the Ewald sphere), not an accuracy limit.

sigma_own_nm2.description: Cross section from this code. Sanity diagnostic only - NOT the shipped sigma.

sigma_bote_nm2.description: The SHIPPED cross section, from the Bote-Salvat parameterization.

badL.description: Partial waves that failed matching. Must be 0.

ortho_c.description: Bound-continuum overlap. Not zero under the relaxed core-hole prescription (different Hamiltonians); ~1e-14 only under exact frozen core.

tail.description: Contract for s beyond the table. schema 2 declares a MEASURED UPPER BOUND, never an extrapolated value.

kind.description: 2 = measured bound. kind 0/1 belong to schema 1 and must be rejected.

eps.description: Upper bound on |F| beyond s_cert: 2.0 * sup|F| measured on [s_cert-2, s_cert], with an absolute floor of 1e-6. *** DO NOT INTERPOLATE eps ACROSS E0 - an interpolated bound is not a bound. Take the max of the two bracketing rows. *** The 1e-6 floor coincides with one quantization code of the packed .bin, and with the s>8 quadrature error 3.2e-7 to within a factor of 3: there is no information below it.

valid_to.description: Equals s_cert_A_inv. Kept for readers that only parse the tail object.

source.description: How eps was measured, in words.
